newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Elbrewery to consolidate firms.
newsitem.headline: Polish Elbrewery to consolidate firms.

text.p: Australian company Brewpole BV, in which Royal Grolsch has a 25-percent stake, will start consolidating its three Polish subsidiaries into a single firm from July 1, the Polish firm's president said on Thursday.
Wieslaw Skrobowski told a news conference that the consolidation of two breweries -- Elbrewery Co., Hevelius Brewing Co -- and the JI Marketing firm will strengthen their position on the market.
"The subsidiaries of Brewpole decided to create one organism out of the three companies...to better meet challenges on the fast growing beer market," Skrobowski said.
Skrobowski said Hevelius Brewing and JI Marketing would be consolidated around Elbrewery Co., which produced 18 percent of Poland's 1996 beer output of more than 16 million hectolitres.
